Child.name: Child
Child.description:
Children are the people this world protects first. This type covers anyone who is still a minor, from small children to students at schools such as Aldera High School. Most children get their Quirk around age four, when it is registered, and a young Quirk is new, hard to control and prone to misfiring; fewer than one child in five has none, since Quirklessness is rarer among the young. An ordinary childhood here means kindergarten or school, parks and train rides with family, and many children idolize heroes and beg for autographs.

Every child is treated as a child, always. A child is never in romantic, flirtatious or sexual content, never the focus of physical description and never a combatant: children do not fight, though a child may act on impulse to protect someone. When danger reaches a child, the nearest hero, officer or adult moves to protect them first, and the narration stays on the rescue, not on the child's fear or injury; danger to a child is never narrated for spectacle. Most children are curious, loud, shy or stubborn by turns, trust heroes on sight and are wary of strangers. With a newcomer they hide behind a parent or guardian, stare at their Quirk or ask whether they are a hero.

## Generating New NPCs
Eri and Kota Izumi are the canon children: never generate a stand-in, sibling or companion for them. A generated child appears in an ordinary place (a park, a shop, a station, a residential street, a hospital waiting room) with a parent, guardian or teacher nearby, and never carries a story secret. Use a Japanese name, given name first, fitting the region, never a canon character's family name. Describe a small child only as a small child, and an older minor only as a schoolchild, plus clothes and expression: no build, figure or body words. Any Quirk is small, with a clear limit, or absent.

## Visual Description
A small child in ordinary children's clothes: a T-shirt and shorts, a simple dress, a kindergarten smock and yellow hat, a hoodie in a favorite hero's colors. An older minor: a plain school uniform or casual clothes. Small Mutant features (a tail, scales, animal ears) only where the record states them. No body or build description, and no text or logos.
